title: Show Your Work in Swahili: Reinforcement Learning for Native-Language Mathematical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.16104v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Fikiria, a two-stage SFT+GRPO recipe for Swahili mathematical reasoning. Its reward multiplies a format gate by a weighted sum of answer accuracy and the ChrF\texttt{++} similarity of the Swahili reasoning to an in-language reference chain of thought, so that training targets the surface fidelity of the reasoning trace and not only the final answer. We train on a 2.3k-problem Swahili dataset created by translating GSM8K with GPT-4.1 and filtering with SSA-COMET. On AfriMGSM Swahili, Fikiria-AfriqueQwen-14B reaches 79.2\%. Under the same fixed prompt and strict answer-format scoring, GPT-4o reaches 68.0\%, partly because it often fails the required answer format; IrokoBench reports 78.8\% for GPT-4o using a best-per-model prompt, a figure numerically close to ours but not directly comparable. translated_title: 用斯瓦希里语展示你的解题过程：面向母语数学推理的强化学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Fikiria，这是一种用于斯瓦希里语数学推理的两阶段SFT+GRPO训练方案。其奖励函数将一个格式门槛乘以答案准确率与斯瓦希里语推理链相对于同语言参考思维链的ChrF++相似度之间的加权和，因此训练不仅针对最终答案，还针对推理轨迹的表层忠实度。我们在一个包含2300道题的斯瓦希里语数据集上进行训练，该数据集通过GPT-4.1翻译GSM8K并用SSA-COMET过滤构建而成。在AfriMGSM斯瓦希里语基准上，Fikiria-AfriqueQwen-14B达到79.2%的成绩。在相同的固定提示和严格的答案格式评分下，GPT-4o达到68.0%，部分原因是它经常无法满足要求的答案格式；IrokoBench报告GPT-4o在使用逐模型最优提示的情况下达到78.8%，这一数值与我们的结果接近但不能直接比较。在一项由共同作者担任标注者的小规模人工评估中，GPT-4o的输出总体上更受青睐。ChrF++衡量的是表层忠实度
tldr: 该论文提出Fikiria方法，通过SFT+GRPO两阶段强化学习，并设计结合答案准确率与推理链ChrF++相似度的奖励函数，提升斯瓦希里语数学推理能力，在AfriMGSM斯瓦希里语基准上以79.2%的成绩超过了GPT-4o。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Fikiria, a two-stage SFT+GRPO recipe whose reward combines answer accuracy with ChrF++ similarity to in-language reference reasoning chains, achieving 79.2% on AfriMGSM Swahili and outperforming GPT-4o under strict format scoring.
